verdict.rationale: doola documents a Partner API with an API reference, but nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of all standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404. The llms.txt index and the MCP server are adjacent AI-facing artifacts, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
